question: 自我反思（Self-Refine/Reflexion）机制的迭代收敛性：量化经过N轮反思后，任务成功率从p_0提升至p_N的曲线，特别是对于长程科研任务（>5步推理），反思机制在第2、3轮的边际增益是否低于10%。

sources.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
sources.snippet: Motivated by how humans refine their written text, we introduce Self-Refine, an approach for improving initial outputs from LLMs through iterative feedback and refinement. The main idea is to generate an initial output using an LLMs; then, the same LLMs provides feedback for its output and uses it to refine itself, iteratively.
